name: Cuberite
description:
Cuberite is a custom, high-performance Minecraft game server written in C++. Designed for speed and minimal resource usage, it handles hundreds of concurrent players on modest hardware while supporting extensible Lua plugins.

Features:
- Extremely lightweight and fast execution written in modern C++
- Low memory footprint compared to traditional Java-based Minecraft servers
- Powerful Lua scripting API for developing custom server plugins and mechanics
- Built-in web administration interface for server monitoring and player management
- Cross-platform architecture compatible with multiple Minecraft client versions
